command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$ssh=(Get-Command ssh -ErrorAction Stop).Source;$remote=@'
hostname
whoami
pwd
echo DIR_CHECK_BEGIN
for p in /home/ubuntu/shopvivaliz-deploy /home/ubuntu/shopvivaliz-deploy/shared /home/ubuntu/shopvivaliz-deploy/current /home/ubuntu/recovery-two-a1 /home/ubuntu/solange-rolla-consultorio /home/ubuntu; do
  if [ -e "$p" ]; then
    echo "EXISTS=$p"
    ls -ld "$p" 2>/dev/null || true
    if [ -L "$p" ]; then
      readlink -f "$p" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
  else
    echo "MISSING=$p"
  fi
done
echo FIND_DEPLOY_BEGIN
find /home/ubuntu -maxdepth 3 \( -type d -name 'shopvivaliz-deploy' -o -type f -name '.env' -o -type l -name '.env' \) 2>/dev/null | sort | head -100
echo FIND_DEPLOY_END
'@;& $ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=15 shopvivaliz-vm $remote;Write-Output ('SSH_RC='+$LASTEXITCODE);exit $LASTEXITCODE
reason: Inspect backend A1 deploy paths safely after scp target failure for OpenAI credential sync
